lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits and pectoral fin; approximately five distinct columns are visible in the mid-lateral flank, with higher spot density in the central region of the flank transitioning to smaller, more widely spaced points dorsally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot alignments, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the lateral line area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank; the medial ridge exhibits the most prominent intensity gradient, characterized by a high-luminance crest and a distinct shadow region directly ventral to the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6 to 8 small, high-luminance circular spots is visible, primarily localized on the anterior lower quadrant of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.
